# MatrixQR Blog

> The official MatrixQR technical blog covering QR code generation, digital menus, client-side processing, and practical privacy and security considerations.

MatrixQR publishes implementation guides and product updates. Privacy and data-handling statements should be read in the context of the specific tool and workflow described. The MatrixQR Blog does not load Google Analytics; hosting providers and third-party assets may still process technical request data.

## Official Resources
- [MatrixQR QR Code Generator](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Main QR code generator website.
- [Digital Menu Tool](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Tools and workflows for digital menus.
- [Privacy Policy](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/privacy-policy): The blog's privacy and data-handling disclosures.

## Latest Articles
- [How to Add a Logo to a QR Code Without Breaking It](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/how-to-add-logo-to-qr-code-without-breaking-it): Learn how to add a logo to a QR code without hurting scan reliability. Covers logo size, error correction, contrast, quiet zones, testing, and export tips.
- [Why Restaurants Should Offer Both Paper and QR Code Menus](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/2026-10/traditional-menus-digital-menu-qr-code): Discover how restaurant QR code menus can complement paper menus, improve access during busy service, and give diners more choice without forcing a fully digital experience.
- [Introducing MatrixQR URL Generator: Free Client-Side Link QR Codes](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/2026-10/introducing-matrixqr-url-generator): Create static website-link QR codes in your browser with custom colors and logo options. MatrixQR processes the QR payload client-side; hosting providers may still process technical request data.
- [How Client-Side Canvas Processing Helps Protect Digital Menu QR Workflows](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/how-we-secured-digital-menu-qr-codes-canvas-sanitization): Learn how client-side Canvas processing can resize, composite, and export images for digital menu QR codes without requiring server-side image processing. Explore CORS limitations and practical security considerations.
- [Free Custom QR Code Generator with Logo](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/custom-qr-code-generator-logo): Learn how to add a logo to a QR code, choose error correction, and test scan reliability. Includes browser-side rendering considerations and practical design guidance.

## vCard & Contact Management
- [vCard QR Codes and Apple Wallet Passes: Compatibility Guide](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/vcard-qr-setup): Learn how vCard QR codes share contact details, how to format international phone numbers, and how Apple Wallet passes differ from standard contact QR codes.

## General
- [Introducing MatrixQR URL Generator: Free Client-Side Link QR Codes](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/2026-10/introducing-matrixqr-url-generator): Create static website-link QR codes in your browser with custom colors and logo options. MatrixQR processes the QR payload client-side; hosting providers may still process technical request data.
- [5 Customizable QR Code Generators: Privacy, Features & Pricing (2026)](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/can-you-recommend-a-qr-code-generator-that-allows-customization): Compare five customizable QR code generators by design options, pricing, and data-handling approach. Learn how to evaluate client-side processing, analytics, and QR code export formats.
- [Convert Menu Image to QR Code: A Practical Privacy Guide for Restaurants](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/image-to-qr-menu-guide): Convert menu image URLs into static QR codes with MatrixQR. Learn how browser-side generation works, what it means for privacy, and why destination availability still matters.
- [Static vs Dynamic QR Codes: Which Is Best for Your Business?](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/static-vs-dynamic-qr): Compare static vs. dynamic QR codes by editability, analytics, privacy, cost, and service dependency. Learn which type best fits your business needs.
- [The Pros and Cons of Static QR Codes: A Complete Technical & Privacy Guide](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/the-pros-and-cons-of-static-qr-codes): Explore static QR code strengths and limitations, including privacy boundaries, destination availability, scan reliability, and practical business use cases.
